sources.name: NASA POWER Daily (AG)
sources.provider: NASA Langley Research Center POWER Project
sources.note: Daily MERRA-2/CERES-derived point values, community AG; fill value -999 converted to null. ALLSKY_SFC_SW_DWN units verified as MJ/m^2/day from the response header. Elevation from the POWER response (941.7 m).

sources.name: SoilGrids v2.0 (mean, 0-30 cm)
sources.provider: ISRIC - World Soil Information (not a NASA product)
sources.note: Mean of the 0-5, 5-15 and 15-30 cm layers weighted by thickness (5:10:15). d_factor 10 applied (g/kg -> %, dg/kg -> g/kg, pH*10 -> pH).

sources.name: MODIS Terra MOD13Q1 NDVI (16-day, 250 m)
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC via ORNL DAAC MODIS Web Service
sources.note: MOD13Q1 v061 250m_16_days_NDVI, scale 0.0001, fill -3000 removed; pixel_reliability filter keeps rank 0 (good) and 1 (marginal), drops 2 (snow/ice), 3 (cloudy), -1 (fill). Single 250 m pixel at the point. 272 composites requested from 2015-01-01; 15 dropped by quality filter.

sources.name: NASA SRTM v3.0 (SRTMGL1) 1 arc-second DEM
sources.provider: NASA / NGA / JPL SRTM, served by the OpenTopoData public API (opentopodata.org, dataset srtm30m)
sources.note: 3 x 3 stencil at 90 m spacing around the point: 3 x 3 samples, bilinear interpolation of the 30 m DEM; slope = mean of per-point finite-difference gradients (metric spacing from WGS84 radii of curvature, central differences), aspect = slope-weighted vector mean of the downhill direction, null if the terrain is flat (< 1 %) or directionless. SRTM is a public-domain NASA product (absolute vertical accuracy about +/- 16 m at 90 % confidence, better relatively); it measures the surface including canopy/buildings. Coverage 60 N to 56 S. OpenTopoData public instance: free, no key, 1 request/s, 1000 requests/day.

sources.name: ERA5 daily precipitation via Open-Meteo Historical Weather API
sources.provider: ECMWF / Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), served by Open-Meteo.com
sources.note: ERA5-Land precipitation was requested first (models=era5_land) but Open-Meteo returns null for it (checked across sites and years on 2026-11-13), so plain ERA5 is the reference instead. Daily sums (UTC) 2001-01-01..2026-11-06 for the grid cell nearest 39.58, 32.15. Licence: Open-Meteo data is CC BY 4.0, free API for non-commercial use (< 10,000 calls/day); required credit: "Weather data by Open-Meteo.com" plus "Generated using Copernicus Climate Change Service information (ERA5/ERA5-Land)" (Copernicus licence CC BY 4.0). Reanalysis precipitation is a model product, not a gauge measurement; both reference and POWER (MERRA-2 corrected) differ from station climatology.
